title: test(dogfood): a walled leg of the sign-up organization census — a real-stack walled sign-up with the audit and email plugins composed leaves 0 NULL organization_id rows (#24343 acceptance)
body:
Filing gate **③**: the unverified acceptance line of #24343, found by the epic seat's reconciliation at `main` `2919ddb875`.
- **Who acts:** the shared queue.
- **Dedupe:** none.

Part of #24343.

## What is on `main`
- Each of #24343's three writers has a walled unit pin:
  - the activity writer, `audit-writers.test.ts:2646`;
  - the grant, `self-registration-grant-first-membership-walled.dogfood.test.ts`;
  - the identity mail, `identity-mail-sibling.test.ts:100-112`.
- Step 4 and 7b-0 make a NULL row impossible.
- But no in-repo real-stack walled census composes the audit and email plugins together: `signup-organization-census.dogfood.test.ts` runs `single` only.

## Wanted
- A walled leg (`group` and `isolated`) of `signup-organization-census.dogfood.test.ts`: sign-up, invitation, verification mail and first membership, then a census of every platform table with the column.
- It is test-only.

## Acceptance
- The walled leg reads 0 NULL `organization_id` rows.
- An ablation (one writer's stamp removed) turns it red.
